entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-05
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • LSP definition locations should use the current target document after edits #86331
  • Unexpected order of evaluation is observed for some scenarios #86329
  • ControlFlowGraph omits the lowering of a lock on System.Threading.Lock when nullable annotations are enabled #86321
    18.14

Closed

  • Incorrect implementation of IsEffectivelyReadOnly API with respect to reduced extension methods and generic construction #86257
    18.14
  • Add support for @layout null in blazor #85443
    Backlog
  • Suboptimal codegen for `is` pattern: binary search prevents JIT from using a bit test #86322

PullRequests

Created

  • Run all Razor formatting tests through DotNetFormat and IDE hosts #86333
    Area-Razor
  • Use current source trees for definition locations after edits #86332
    Community, VSCode
  • Ensure that Length getter cannot change reference-type receiver before implicit indexing or slicing completes #86330
    Area-Compilers
  • Address some additional comments for project data props file generation #86328
  • Inline arrays: disallow capture with address-of #86325
    Area-Compilers
  • Partial members: avoid missing diagnostics from implementation-only semantic models #86324
    Area-Compilers
  • Lock object: fix CFG with nullable differences #86323
    Area-Compilers
  • Format Hover #86320
    Community, VSCode
  • Preserve configured line endings in metadata source #86319
    Community, VSCode
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86318

Merged

  • Remove temporary-path plumbing from the compilation path #86326
    Next
  • Fix implementation of IsEffectivelyReadOnly API for reduced generic extension methods #86291
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Simplify ProjectData atomic write and temp directory routing #86327
    Community, Next
  • Support `@layout null` in Razor v12 #86300

  • Migrate Roslyn Integration CI DartLab pipeline to DartLab1ES #86196
    Next

    Community, VSCode, Next
  • Use Roslyn Contract validation instead of VS validation #86315
    Area-Razor, Next

    Community, Area-Razor
